verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs state the engine is designed to be worked with entirely from the command line (godot-docs-3, godot-docs-12, godot-probe-4) and document headless operation (godot-docs-19, godot-docs-27). A runtime probe confirms a one-command keyless Homebrew install giving a `godot --headless` binary used for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation (godot-probe-rt-1). missing for 10: detailed evidence of specific CLI flags and subcommands (e.g. export and script-run options), evidence of machine-readable/structured CLI output suited to agent consumption.
